damage_history.description: Overvoltage surge on GPIO header during sensor testing. Board power LED unlit; PMIC Dialog DA9091 thermal scorching observed.

ai_diagnosis.diagnostic_title: PMIC Overvoltage Meltdown & Rail Short Circuit
ai_diagnosis.fault_mechanism: Exceeded 3.3V GPIO tolerance, triggering thermal breakdown in on-board power management IC (PMIC). 5V rail grounded.
ai_diagnosis.safety_details: Overheated inductor and charred SMD capacitors. Risk of bench power supply trip. Keep disconnected.
ai_diagnosis.recommended_action: Quarantine board and replace with spare Raspberry Pi 5 unit.
recommended_directives: Decommission board from active lab bench immediately
Audit 12V bench power supply regulation circuit before testing further units
Issue spare IoT kit to firmware team
ai_diagnosis.warranty_claim_viability: Void due to electrical overstress / user short circuit

ai_diagnosis.diagnostic_title: Sub-surface Panel Fracture & Backlight Inverter Anomaly
ai_diagnosis.fault_mechanism: High-impact physical shock caused stress cracks across display substrate. Ribbon interconnect or digitizer matrix shows electrical discontinuity.
ai_diagnosis.safety_details: Moderate glass fragmentation hazard. Avoid pressing damaged bezel.
ai_diagnosis.operational_impact: Critical: Visual output compromised; high risk of total backlight failure.
ai_diagnosis.recommended_action: Stage unit for OEM display panel replacement; issue temporary loaner workstation.
recommended_directives: Initiate Dell ProSupport warranty RMA inspection
Provide loaner monitor to designer workstation
ai_diagnosis.warranty_claim_viability: Active OEM warranty found (Valid until 2029-03-20). File claim under accidental/hardware coverage.
